name: scriptoscope
description: A Kaleidoscope-compatible window manager and theme engine for the web. Renders classic Mac OS schemes from their original binary resources (cicn/wnd#/cinf/ppat/Colr).
author: Ken Hawkins

scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-css-to-dist.mjs && node scripts/copy-loader-declarations.mjs
scripts.build:demo: npm run build && vite build --config vite.demo.config.js && node scripts/copy-demo-assets.mjs
scripts.build:themes: node scripts/extract-scheme.mjs --all && node scripts/extract-icons.mjs --all && node scripts/index-rasters.mjs && node scripts/gen-resource-roles.mjs && node scripts/gen-themes-manifest.mjs
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tools/theme-loader/*.test.mjs tools/sit-wasm/*.test.mjs src/declarative/*.test.mjs src/*.test.mjs tests/rendering-requirements/*.test.mjs tests/control-availability/*.test.mjs tests/reference-captures/*.test.mjs
scripts.gates: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint:themes -- --strict && npm run audit:scenes -- --check && npm run test:requirements && npm run test:availability:sources && npm run test:references
scripts.test:rendering:extended: npm run build && SCRIPTOSCOPE_RENDERING_PROFILE=extended playwright test --config tests/rendering-options/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:rendering:goldens: npm run build && SCRIPTOSCOPE_RENDERING_GOLDENS=1 playwright test --config tests/rendering-options/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:rendering:goldens:update: npm run build && SCRIPTOSCOPE_RENDERING_GOLDENS=1 SCRIPTOSCOPE_UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 playwright test --config tests/rendering-options/playwright.config.mjs
